JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 11 · The entry

The Service Module is cast off, and the Command Module turns its heat shield to the Earth. A quarter of an hour later, 122 km up at eleven kilometres a second, the first of the air: a pale light in the windows that grows to a fire you fly inside, the load coming on to six and a half times your weight, the radio gone. Then it eases, Houston is there again, and you are falling towards the Pacific. Sit down in a chair before you start; lean back if you can.

In the headset: B runs time faster and A slower (hold A for real time), ten times at most; X is the big window to your left, Y looks from outside, right stick press to sit right again.

On this screen: drag to look, Space start or pause, W faster, S slower, C window, O outside, the number keys jump.
